featured_reviews.name: Sakshi Naik
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pre-Operative Phase
About for a  year, I grappled with persistent nasal congestion, mouth breathing, and disrupted sleep due to a deviated nasal septum and enlarged inferior turbinates. After thorough consultations and diagnostic evaluations, my ENT specialist Dr Sanjay Bhatia recommended a combined septoplasty and inferior turbinoplasty to alleviate these issues. The pre-operative process was seamless; he provided detailed explanations of the procedures, potential risks, and expected outcomes, which instilled confidence and eased my apprehensions.

Surgical Experience
The surgery was performed under general anesthesia and lasted approximately 2 hours. Post-operatively, I experienced mild discomfort, primarily due to nasal packing, which is typical in such procedures. Pain was manageable with prescribed medications, and I was discharged the following day with clear post-operative care instructions.

Post-Operative Phase
The initial days (approximately 2 days ) were challenging, with significant nasal congestion and reliance on mouth breathing. The prescribed medications helped manage discomfort.Nasal passages continued to heal, with reduced crusting and improved airflow. I noticed a significant improvement in sleep quality and a decrease in daytime fatigue.

Follow up (after a week of Operation)
Follow-up ensured proper healing and addressed any concerns promptly. During my follow-up appointments, Dr. provided a comprehensive regimen to support healing and alleviate discomfort.

Final Thoughts
Undergoing septoplasty with inferior turbinoplasty was a transformative experience. The procedure addressed long-standing issues, leading to improved breathing, better sleep, and enhanced quality of life.
I am deeply grateful to Dr. Sanjay Bhatia for his exceptional expertise and compassionate care throughout my journey. His profound knowledge in ENT, and surgery, combined with his empathetic approach, made a significant difference in my treatment experience. Dr. Bhatia's dedication to patient well-being and his commitment to excellence are truly commendable. Thank you, Dr. Bhatia, for making this journey smoother and for being a beacon of hope and healing.
